fixed_project_startup.command: DEMO_STATE_DIR=/tmp/sre-agent-mcp-live/.demo-state docker compose -p sre-agent-ca5-fixed --project-directory /tmp/sre-agent-issue187-fix --env-file /tmp/issue187-ca5-fixed.env -f /tmp/sre-agent-issue187-fix/compose.yaml -f /tmp/sre-agent-issue187-fix/compose.mcp.yaml -f /tmp/issue187-ca5-fixed-network.override.yaml up -d mcp-seed api
fixed_project_startup.observed: Database healthy; migration, seed, and MCP-seed completed; API healthy.

metrics_scrape.command: docker exec sre-agent-ca5-fixed-api-1 python -c 'import urllib.request; b=urllib.request.urlopen("http://grafana-mcp:8000/metrics",timeout=5).read().decode(); xs=[x for x in b.splitlines() if x.startswith("mcp_server_operation_duration_seconds_count{") and "mcp_method_name=\"tools/call\"" in x]; print("tools_call_total",sum(int(x.rsplit(" ",1)[1]) for x in xs)); [print(x) for x in xs]'
metrics_scrape.observed_totals: denial scrape 1; allowed scrape 2; one query_prometheus tools/call series; no MCP request intervened.
